projects.name: ODOT 8-Year Work Plan Roads 2027-2034 (Work Plan Roadways)
projects.notes: Everything in the layer is planned (8-year construction work plan, federal fiscal years 2027-2037 in PROGRAM_FED_YR). No status field; T_LET_DATE_YEAR/T_LET_DATE_MONTH exist but were null in the sample, so PROGRAM_FED_YR is the schedule. Work codes 86:RIGHT OF WAY and 91:UTILITIES are separate job pieces that mark right-of-way acquisition. County is a number (COUNTY_NO), not a name. ODOT republishes under a new service name each October (..._2026to2033, ..._2027to2034).

projects.name: ODOT 8-Year Work Plan Bridges 2027-2034 (Work Plan Bridges)
projects.notes: Bridges in the same 8-year plan; WORK_CODE uses the same numeric codes as the roads layer (text is in the roads layer's T_PROJ_WORK_DESC). PROG_FED_YR 2027-2037.

parcels_statewide_note: No free statewide parcel layer with owner names was found for Oklahoma.

parcels_counties.notes: Tulsa County Assessor data served by INCOG. Description says 'Last updated February 3, 2025' but LoadDate/sale dates in the sample are from late 2025/2026. Name1/Name2 also hold owner names.

parcels_counties_note: Not found or not reachable in the time allowed: Oklahoma, Cleveland, Canadian, Comanche counties (ArcGIS Online search turned up only small or third-party extracts; Rogers, Wagoner and Caddo county layers with owners exist but are not among the most populous).
summary: Projects: ODOT 8-Year Work Plan road lines and bridge points (FFY 2027-2037) verified, all planned work with cost and program year. Parcels: no statewide owner layer; only Tulsa County verified, Oklahoma County and the others not found.
